notes.title: The Ratatoskr Update is here!
notes.notes:
Are you ready, Squirrel Squad?

A new rival arrives and joins forces with Mother & Father to destroy the neighborhood! Commanded to whip up a cyclone that wreaks havoc in the neighborhood, Ratatoskr awaits our hero Squirrel atop the debris at the Golden Acorn Tree. Can Squirrel overcome this new challenge and defeat Ratatoskr to save the neighborhood?  

Watch The Ratatoskr Update trailer!
[previewyoutube=E6SyairX7oU;full][/previewyoutube]

Tackle the new Super Platforming Challenge as you reach new heights navigating the cyclone debris to take on the new boss. But keep a sharp eye—those pesky agents are very motivated to take you out before you get there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/f3daad8bd1514f610f34c7b14d2a291e684e8731.jpg

The fight against Ratatoskr is quite unlike the vehicle-based bosses you've faced before. The mythical squirrel moves fast, has a variety of ranged and melee attacks, and is a considerably smaller target! Fortunately, you will be granted a special SMG with a magazine of infinite bullets for the occasion. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/374a8618f592b751fee490d2ac7893f66d9cc8d1.jpg

Though it is a disputed feature among historians, we wanted our adaptation of Ratatoskr to make use of a horn/tusk in combat. It can use the horn/tusk as a devastating frontal attack, or drill into the ground and burst out from under the player. It can even grow in size and be used as a melee weapon. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/c3251175f34bcf44d70a0d3757486c845d30ec7a.jpg

Our hero squirrel is not one to comprehend intricacies like blocking and dodging, but it definitely knows a thing or two about shooting! Using the gun and quick reflexes, you will be able to block and even deflect attacks back at Ratatoskr.

UPDATE 1.4.3.0: 
New levels: 

 Super Platformer level
 Ratatoskr boss fight

New Outfits: 

 Cauldron outfit (a la Getting Over It) as a reward for beating the Super Platformer with less than 5 deaths 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/dd1a583844524e2eeb26c2281d61bf6df446b0df.jpg

 "Chained" outfit (a la Chained Together) as a reward for beating the Super Platformer with 0 deaths

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/a6d79bcb8e733769bb15fd5f60f5d27922e3c319.jpg

 Corrupted Norse Squirrel, awarded for beating Ratatoskr

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/159dd228644a935ad779ae7e880b8aae2a5430fc.jpg

 Divine Norse Squirrel, awarded for beating Ratatoskr 3x and then a 4th time, where he will be gold and more difficult

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/fb489ca9fb2a609662a3a96d34fa003a23685e75.jpg


Do you have what it takes to take on Ratatoskr? Play the update now to find out! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/82bd717b935825a1a5623be587c94c69c24b8a6c.png

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/81a2bdea0bca6297be13066e9ba4a50c5b2c12b2.png

We wanted to take a minute to say a huge THANK YOU to everyone who has played Squirrel With a Gun thus far! It has brought us so much joy to see all the shenanigans you are getting up to in the game.

We are paying close attention to all bug reports and issues, and are excited to roll out our first major patch of the game (more to come!). The best way to let us know about bugs is through Steam discussions or our Discord channel. 

Patch Notes 1.0.2: 


 Fixed the cause of some random crashing that was related to hint boxes
 Game will auto-save when grabbing important collectables like the Golden Acorns. Currently, auto-save will only function in The Neighborhood!
 Added 1 Reload Wedge to the Neighborhood, so the total number of Reload Wheels is a whole number.
 Fixed bug that was ejecting players out of water slides before they reached the end.
 Various smaller bug fixes and optimizations.


Our team at Dee Dee Creations has been hard at work on this game for over two years now, so you can imagine how exciting this week has been seeing the game finally get into your paws. Go nuts!

notes.title: Squirrel With A Gun's PC release has been commemorated by a day-long stream of real life squirrels doing squirrel things in someone's garden
notes.notes: Squirrel with a Gun, that game about squirrels with guns, releases on PC today, August 29, and its developers have decided to commemorate this by allowing its Steam page to play host to a day-long livestream or real squirrels mucking about. As of wrioting, it's still going, and it's pretty cool.If you're out of the loop, Squirrel With A Gun has gone from ">a thing that just made for fun Twitter videos a few years ago to a thing that's now actually coming out on PC and console, and it's about exactly what you'd have expected, as well as some platforming you might not have.To celebrate this being the day the game unlocks on Steam and the Epic Store, its developers have elected to throw a livestreamed party for some actual squirrels, with help from a Youtube channel called, Backyard Buddies, which basically looks like it's doing the whole Springwatch thing of letting you watch animals just live their lives. Yep, call your aunt and uncle who own 15 million birdfeeders and take in hedgehogs, the games are catering to them now. Read more

notes.title: Squirrel With A Gun has now loaded a console release date into its pistol alongside the PC bullet it already had, and my hands are very much up
notes.notes: If you've been on social media over the past couple of years and are into the video game, odds are you've seen or heard of Squirrel with a Gun. It's a game in which you play as a Squirrel with a gun, and it's just had a console release date revealed to go alongside the PC one that's locked in for (checks watch) next week.We actually reported on Squirrel With A Gun back when it was just short clips of a squirrel firing a gun against the backdrop of one of those early game development non-environments, and everyone was going 'phwoar, that looks like it'd be a fun game'. It now is one, and it's coming out, though it remains to be seen if it'll have the depth or staying power of something like Goat Simulator.Anyway, having already been slapped with a PC release date of August 29, the game that's emerged from those videos thanks to developer Dee Dee Creations and publisher Maximum Entertainment, the game's now got a proper console one. It'll be hitting Xbox Series X/S and PS5 on October 15 this year, as revealed in the fresh trailer you can watch below. Read more

notes.title: The Post-release Free Content Roadmap is here!
notes.notes:
Hellloooo Squirrel Squad!

Get ready to go nuts because today, at this very moment, we’re unveiling our post-release Squirrel With A Gun Content Roadmap! Yep, you’ve heard that right—the game's launch is just the beginning. Once Squirrel With a Gun is out, we’re not stopping with production and we’ve got a stash of FREE updates coming your way. 

Curious to know more? You are!? Perfect. In that case let’s cut to the intro music, show that flashy logo animation, and…. let’s go!

Squirrels, feast your eyes on the SEVEN incredible post-release updates, all coming to you for free!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/29c2b931dff3a9210d808d1aea79d386b281d597.png


 First up, we will introduce Photo Mode with a free-roaming camera. From daring stunts to stylish poses, show off your squirrel psycho-cool moments in stunning snapshots with the all-new free roam camera. In short, the chaos is  getting cinematic. 
 Next is the Super Platforming Challenge level. This thrilling new level is designed to push your gun-jumping prowess to the limit. 
 Around that same timing, you will also get A New Rival. Just when you thought you had the city (and agents) under control, a mysterious new threat emerges. 
 Early next year, the Outfit Variety Pack is coming your way. Expect a range of swanky new costumes to keep you looking sharp and stylish. 
 Spring 2025 will bring the Gravity Gun, a game-changing gadget from the lab that lets you manipulate objects with gravity (imagine the chaos)! 
 June 2025 will bring the Squirr-LGBT update which features a set of pride fits. Be gay, do crime! (Just like squirrels. Yep, look it up—Squirrels can be gay AND do crime.)
 And finally, in Summer 2025, a set of new furs will transform your Squirrel into other adorable forest critters. We call this update The Varmint Collection. Let’s get wild. 

Keep in mind that those dates are not final and may change. It is video game development afterall. 


We hope that these updates have you as hyped as we are for what's to come. Just five more weeks until we can commit Squirrel crimes together on August 29!

We’ll be sharing more updates with you as we get along to the finish line, so don't forget to join our Squirrel Squad and follow us on X and TikTok for the latest news, sneak peeks, and more content from the game.

Stay nutty, and see you soon!
